purpose: One title in a shelf or grid: poster or landscape art, facts on the art (rating, NEW/HOT, certificate, progress), and a caption below or over the art. Hold opens the confirmation sheet; OK opens the title or resumes it.

source.android: BrowseActivity CardHolder / poster card builders; SearchActivity and SectionActivity reuse the same cards

anatomy.note: Poster 2:3 or landscape 16:9; inset plate for Glass; rounded to radius.card.
Top-left: rating (star + value), NEW/HOT; top-right: certificate; bottom: progress for Continue.
Below art (or over it when caption=overlay), 1 line, ellipsis.
Year · genre, or S01E04 · 52m; 1 line, ink2.
Pack focus language: ring, lift or glow; scale and glow come from tokens.

rank.numeral: 0.8 of card width, behind/beside the poster

rules: A shelf is one row: LEFT/RIGHT step tiles, and LEFT on the first tile may open the rail.
UP/DOWN move between shelves keeping the horizontal position (nearest overlapping tile).
OK on a hero tile plays; OK on a shelf tile opens Detail; OK on Continue resumes.
Hold opens the confirmation sheet and never acts immediately.

behaviour: Badges ride on the art with a scrim so the poster still reads; no badge floats in the caption.
A title with no art still gets a tile; its fallback is the title on the pack surface, not a blank hole.
Progress is the profile's real playhead, saved every 10s and on pause/stop.
Tile width never changes between themes; only the radius, wash and focus language do.

platformDeltas.ios: Long-press opens the same sheet as a context menu; hover/press lifts, not scales.
platformDeltas.windows: Hover reveals the same badges/title; right-click opens the sheet; keyboard focus ring.
platformDeltas.apple-tv: Focus lift + parallax; caption appears on focus; hold = same sheet.
